    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Houston ~ Fr. 'où sont' (where are) + 'ton' (tone, sound); où sont = where are",

    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5

    "operation": "anagram",

    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "H (house, heh) + O (circle, sun) + U (vessel) + S (serpent) + T (cross) + O (circle) + N (fish, nun)",

    "languages": ["en", "he", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4

  {
    "operation": "numerical",

    "reading": "The number four — grounded foundation, the square of the house made manifest",

    "languages": ["en", "fr", "ang"],

  }
